opportunities.name: Enterprise car rental search and select
opportunities.description: Search Enterprise for a rental by pick-up location, optional different return location, dates and times, then browse, sort or filter vehicles, and select one.
steps: Type the pick-up location and pick a suggestion
Optionally tick 'Return to a different location' and enter the return location
Sort by price low to high and apply filters such as passengers or vehicle type
